title: Rational minimal models of almost-complex-structure components on closed connected six-manifolds with vanishing first Betti number and nonzero c1c2-minus-c3 number
author: Gustavo Granja; Aleksandar Milivojević
work: Topology of Almost Complex Structures on Six-Manifolds
source_version: Official SIGMA 18 (2022) article 093, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2022.093; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-09-30, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The proof uses the canonical positive spinor bundle to replace the almost-complex section component by a circle quotient of sphere-bundle sections. It computes the rationalized section space, uses the nonzero Chern number to force the degree-one transgression, and eliminates the resulting acyclic generator pair from a Sullivan model. This ties spinorial geometry to the fundamental group and the full rational homotopy model of a function-space component; the base manifold itself need not be nilpotent.

source_check.note: Complete author Theorem4.4 derivation in Section4 and essential spinorial local supports2.2/2.3 and3.1/3.3 are supplied. M is closed connected and six-dimensional, equipped with the chosen almost complex J, b1(M)=0 and integral_M(c1c2-c3)!=0. The result concerns the component of J in the space of almost complex structures, equivalently the orthogonal component after choosing a metric; it gives nilpotency, finite cyclic fundamental group and the stated free zero-differential minimal model with generator multiplicities b4,b3,b2. The fibration4.1 and the generator elimination are explicit author constructions. Prior section-space rationalization, Thom mapping-space calculation and Crabb–Sutherland fundamental-group theorem are identified background. No nilpotency of M, integrability of J or all-component connectedness is claimed; intersection and four-dimensional variants are contextual only. Source approval supplied only by exact frozen root input; no new source/difficulty decision or mathematical referee.
